title.zh: 卷272 列傳五十九 汤若望 杨光先 南怀仁
title.en: Volume 272 Biographies 59: Tang Ruowang, Yang Guangxian, Nan Huai Ren
title.raw: 卷272 列傳五十九 汤若望 杨光先 南怀仁

sentences.zh: 列傳五十九

translations.literal: Biographies 59
translations.idiomatic: Biographies 59

sentences.zh: 湯若望楊光先南懷仁

translations.literal: Tang Ruowang, Yang Guangxian, and Nan Huai Ren
translations.idiomatic: Tang Ruowang, Yang Guangxian, and Nan Huai Ren

sentences.zh: 湯若望，初名約翰亞當沙耳，姓方白耳氏，日耳曼國人。

translations.literal: Tang Ruowang, whose original name was Johann Adam Schall, surname von Bell, was a native of Germany.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Ruowang—born Johann Adam Schall, of the von Bell family—was a German.

sentences.zh: 明萬曆間，利瑪竇挾天算之學入中國，徐光啟與遊，盡其術。

translations.literal: During the Wanli reign of Ming, Matteo Ricci brought astronomical and mathematical learning into China; Xu Guangqi associated with him and mastered his techniques.
translations.idiomatic: In the Wanli era, Matteo Ricci introduced Western astronomy and mathematics to China, and Xu Guangqi studied with him until he had mastered the art.

sentences.zh: 崇禎初，日食失驗，光啟上言：「台官用郭守敬法，歷久必差，宜及時修正。」

translations.literal: At the beginning of Chongzhen, a solar eclipse prediction failed verification; Guangqi memorialized the throne: "The Board astronomers use Guo Shoujing's methods, which over time must diverge; the calendar should be revised in good time.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Chongzhen reign, when a predicted solar eclipse missed, Xu Guangqi submitted a memorial: "The Astronomical Bureau still uses Guo Shoujing's methods; given enough years, error is inevitable—the calendar ought to be corrected now."

sentences.zh: 莊烈帝用其議，設局修改曆法，光啟為監督，湯若望被徵入局掌推算。

translations.literal: Emperor Sizong adopted his proposal, established a bureau to revise the calendar, appointed Guangqi as superintendent, and summoned Tang Ruowang into the bureau to take charge of calculations.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen accepted the proposal, set up a bureau to reform the calendar, made Xu Guangqi its superintendent, and called Tang Ruowang in to direct the computations.

sentences.zh: 光啟卒，以李天經代，奏進湯若望所著書及𢗝星屏障。

translations.literal: When Guangqi died, Li Tianjing replaced him and memorialized presenting Tang Ruowang's writings and a celestial globe.
translations.idiomatic: After Xu Guangqi died, Li Tianjing succeeded him and presented Tang Ruowang's books and a celestial globe to the throne.

sentences.zh: 迭與台官測日食，候節氣，並考定置閏先後，湯若望術輒驗。

translations.literal: Repeatedly together with Board astronomers he measured solar eclipses, observed seasonal nodes, and investigated the order of intercalary months; Tang Ruowang's methods always proved accurate.
translations.idiomatic: They tested solar eclipses and seasonal terms against the Board astronomers again and again, and settled the sequence of intercalations—Tang Ruowang's calculations always checked out.

sentences.zh: 莊烈帝知西法果密，欲據以改大統術，未行而明亡。

translations.literal: Emperor Sizong knew the Western methods were indeed precise and wished to adopt them to reform the Datong system, but before this could be carried out the Ming fell.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen saw that the Western system was genuinely precise and intended to replace the Datong calendar with it—but the dynasty collapsed before he could act.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，睿親王多爾袞定京師，是歲六月，湯若望啟言：「臣於明崇禎二年來京，用西洋新法釐正舊曆，制測量日月星晷、定時考驗諸器。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi, Prince Regent Dorgon secured the capital; that year in the sixth month Tang Ruowang memorialized: "Your servant came to the capital in the second year of Chongzhen of Ming, used the new Western methods to rectify the old calendar, and made instruments for measuring the sun, moon, and stars, shadows, timekeeping, and verification.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1, after Prince Regent Dorgon took Beijing, Tang Ruowang wrote in the sixth month: "I reached the capital in Chongzhen 2, corrected the old calendar by Western methods, and built instruments to measure the sun, moon, and stars, mark shadows, and keep time for verification.

sentences.zh: 近遭賊毀，擬重製進呈。

translations.literal: Recently they were destroyed by rebels; I propose to remanufacture and present them.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits recently destroyed them; I propose to rebuild and submit them anew.

sentences.zh: 先將本年八月初一日日食，照新法推步。

translations.literal: First, according to the new methods, I have calculated the solar eclipse on the first day of the eighth month of this year.
translations.idiomatic: First, I have computed this year's solar eclipse on the first day of the eighth month by the new method.

sentences.zh: 京師日食限分秒並起復方位，與各省所見不同諸數，開列呈覽。」

translations.literal: The limits in degrees, minutes, and seconds of the eclipse at Beijing and the directions of first contact and totality, along with the various figures differing from what other provinces will see, are listed for submission and inspection.
translations.idiomatic: I attach the eclipse limits to the second for Beijing, the points of first and last contact, and how each province's view will differ."

sentences.zh: 王命湯若望修正曆法。

translations.literal: The prince ordered Tang Ruowang to revise the calendar.
translations.idiomatic: Dorgon ordered Tang Ruowang to revise the calendar.

sentences.zh: 七月，禮部啟請頒歷，王言：「治歷明時，帝王所重。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, the Ministry of Rites memorialized requesting issuance of the calendar; the prince said: "Regulating the calendar and clarifying the seasons is what emperors esteem.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the Ministry of Rites asked permission to issue the calendar. Dorgon replied: "Ordering the calendar and marking the seasons is among an emperor's gravest duties.

sentences.zh: 今用新法正歷，以敬迓天休，宜名​​時憲歷，用稱朝廷憲天乂民之至意。

translations.literal: Now using the new method to correct the calendar, to reverently receive Heaven's blessings, it should be named the Shixian Calendar, to express the court's utmost intent in conforming to Heaven and governing the people.
translations.idiomatic: Since we now correct the calendar by the new method, in reverence for Heaven's favor, it should be called the Shixian Calendar—'Observing Heaven's Norm'—fitting the court's purpose of harmonizing with Heaven and bringing order to the people.

sentences.zh: 自順治二年始，即用新歷頒行天下。」

translations.literal: Beginning from the second year of Shunzhi, the new calendar shall be issued throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: From Shunzhi 2 onward, the new calendar shall be promulgated empire-wide."

sentences.zh: 湯若望復啟言：「敬授人時，全以節氣交宮，與太陽出入、晝夜時刻為重。

translations.literal: Tang Ruowang further memorialized: "In reverently bestowing human time, what matters entirely is the solar terms' passage through the lodges, and the sun's rising and setting and the times of day and night.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Ruowang added: "To give the people correct time, nothing matters more than the solar terms crossing the lodges, and the sun's times of rising, setting, and the hours of day and night.

sentences.zh: 今節氣、日時、刻分與太陽出入、晝夜時刻，俱照道里遠近推算，增加歷首，以協民時，利民用。」

translations.literal: Now the solar terms, days and hours, and quarter-hours, along with the sun's rising and setting and the times of day and night, are all calculated according to distance near and far, added to the calendar header, to harmonize with the people's time and benefit the people's use.
translations.idiomatic: Solar terms, clock times, and sun-rise and sun-set tables for day and night should now be computed for each distance from the capital, added to the calendar's front matter, so local time aligns with the people and serves daily life."

sentences.zh: 王獎其精確。

translations.literal: The prince praised its precision.
translations.idiomatic: Dorgon praised the precision of the proposal.

sentences.zh: 八月丙​​辰朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the eighth month, day bingchen, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, the first day of the eighth month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 王令大學士馮銓與湯若望率欽天監官赴觀像台測驗，惟新法吻合，大統、回回二法時刻俱不協。

translations.literal: The prince ordered Grand Secretary Feng Quan and Tang Ruowang to lead Astronomical Bureau officials to the observatory platform for testing; only the new method matched, while the Datong and Muslim methods both failed to agree on the times.
translations.idiomatic: Dorgon sent Grand Secretary Feng Quan and Tang Ruowang with Bureau officials to the observatory—the new method alone matched observation; Datong and Muslim reckoning both missed the times.

sentences.zh: 世祖定鼎京師，十一月，以湯若望掌欽天監事。

translations.literal: When the Shizu Emperor established the capital at Beijing, in the eleventh month Tang Ruowang was put in charge of Astronomical Bureau affairs.
translations.idiomatic: After the Shunzhi Emperor made Beijing the capital, in the eleventh month he placed Tang Ruowang in charge of the Astronomical Bureau.

sentences.zh: 湯若望疏辭，上不許。

translations.literal: Tang Ruowang memorialized to decline; the emperor did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Ruowang asked to be excused; the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 又疏請別給敕印，而以監印繳部，謂治歷之責，學道之志，庶可並行不悖，上亦不許。

translations.literal: He again memorialized requesting a separate imperial seal be granted, while the Bureau seal be returned to the ministry, saying the duty of governing the calendar and the aspiration of studying the Way could thus proceed without conflict; the emperor also did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked for a personal imperial seal and to surrender the Bureau seal to the ministry, arguing that calendar duty and religious vocation could then coexist—the emperor again said no.

sentences.zh: 並諭湯若望遵旨率屬精修曆法，整頓監規，如有怠玩侵紊，即行參奏。

translations.literal: He also instructed Tang Ruowang to obey the order, lead his subordinates in carefully refining the calendar, and put the Bureau regulations in order; if there were negligence, laxity, or irregularities, he should immediately memorialize against them.
translations.idiomatic: Shunzhi further ordered Tang Ruowang to lead his staff in refining the calendar and tightening Bureau rules, and to report any slackness or misconduct at once.

sentences.zh: 加太僕寺卿，尋改太常寺卿。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Vice Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud; soon after changed to Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Vice Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud, then transferred to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 十年三月，賜號通玄教師，敕曰：「國家肇造鴻業，以授時定歷為急務。

translations.literal: In the third month of the tenth year he was granted the title Master who Penetrates the Mysteries; the edict said: "The state, at the founding of its great enterprise, regards bestowing time and fixing the calendar as urgent tasks.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Shunzhi 10 he received the title Master of Penetrating Mysteries. The edict read: "A dynasty at its founding treats fixing time and calendar as urgent business.

sentences.zh: 羲和而後，如漢洛下閎、張衡，唐李淳風、僧一行，於曆法代有損益。

translations.literal: Since Xihe, men such as Luoxia Hong and Zhang Heng of Han, Li Chunfeng and the monk Yixing of Tang, in each generation made additions and subtractions to calendrical methods.
translations.idiomatic: Since the calendar minister Xihe, Han had Luoxia Hong and Zhang Heng, Tang had Li Chunfeng and the monk Yixing—each age revised the calendar in turn.

sentences.zh: 元郭守敬號為精密，然經緯之度，尚不能符合天行，其後晷度遂以積差。

translations.literal: Yuan's Guo Shoujing was famed for precision, yet even his degrees of longitude and latitude could not fully accord with celestial motion; afterward gnomon measurements gradually accumulated error.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan's Guo Shoujing was called exacting, yet even his longitudes and latitudes never fully matched heaven's motion; gnomon readings drifted ever farther off.

sentences.zh: 爾湯若望來自西洋，精於象緯，閎通曆法。

translations.literal: You, Tang Ruowang, coming from the Western Ocean, are skilled in astral patterns and versed in calendar methods.
translations.idiomatic: You, Tang Ruowang, came from the West, master astral patterns, and grasp calendrical method through and through.

sentences.zh: 徐光啟特薦於朝，一時專家治歷如魏文魁等，實不及爾。

translations.literal: Xu Guangqi especially recommended you to the court; calendar specialists of the time such as Wei Wenkui truly did not equal you.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Guangqi singled you out to the court; reigning calendar men like Wei Wenkui could not match you.

sentences.zh: 但以遠人，多忌成功，終不見用。

translations.literal: Yet because you were a foreigner, many envied your success and in the end you were not employed.
translations.idiomatic: Yet as a foreigner you met envy; despite your gifts, Ming never fully used you.

sentences.zh: 朕承天眷，定鼎之初，爾為朕脩大清時憲歷，迄於有成。

translations.literal: I, receiving Heaven's favor, at the founding of the capital you for me compiled the Great Qing Shixian Calendar, until it was completed.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven favored me; at the founding you compiled the Great Qing Shixian Calendar for me until it stood complete.

sentences.zh: 又能潔身持行，盡心乃事。

translations.literal: You also kept your person pure in conduct and devoted your heart to your duties.
translations.idiomatic: You kept your conduct clean and gave your duties your full heart.

sentences.zh: 今特錫爾嘉名，俾知天生賢人，佐佑定歷，補數千年之闕略，非偶然也。」

translations.literal: Now I specially bestow upon you this honored name, so you may know that Heaven produces wise men to assist in fixing the calendar, filling a lacuna of several thousand years—it is no accident.
translations.idiomatic: I now grant this honorific title so you may know Heaven sends able men to fix the calendar and fill gaps of millennia—no accident."

sentences.zh: 旋復加通政使，進秩正一品。

translations.literal: Soon after he was further promoted to Commissioner of the Office of Transmission and advanced to rank 1a.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made Commissioner of the Office of Transmission and raised to rank 1a.

sentences.zh: 欽天監舊設回回科，湯若望用新法，久之，罷回回科不置。

translations.literal: The Astronomical Bureau had long maintained a Muslim section; Tang Ruowang used the new method, and after a time the Muslim section was abolished and not reestablished.
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau had long kept a Muslim astronomy section; once Tang Ruowang's new method took hold, that section was abolished for good.

sentences.zh: 十四年四月，革職回回科秋官正吳明炫疏言：「臣祖默沙亦黑等一十八姓，本西域人。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fourteenth year, dismissed Muslim section Autumn Officer Wu Mingxuan memorialized: "My ancestor Mashayihei and eighteen clans were originally people of the Western Regions.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Shunzhi 14, the dismissed Muslim section's Autumn Officer Wu Mingxuan wrote: "My forebear Mashayihei and seventeen other clans were Western Region families.

sentences.zh: 自隋開皇己未，抱其歷學，重譯來朝，授職歷官，歷一千五十九載，專管星宿行度。

translations.literal: Since jiwei of Kaihuang in Sui, bearing their calendrical learning, they came to court through retranslation, received office and served through successive appointments, for one thousand five hundred fifty-nine years exclusively managing the positions and movements of star lodges.
translations.idiomatic: Since Sui Kaihuang jiwei they brought their calendar science, came to court by reinterpretation, and served in office for 1,559 years, charged solely with star lodges and their motion.

sentences.zh: 順治三年，掌印湯若望諭臣科，凡日月交食及太陰五星陵犯、天象佔驗，俱不必奏進。

translations.literal: In the third year of Shunzhi, Chief Tang Ruowang instructed our section that all solar and lunar eclipses, lunar and five-planet encroachments, and celestial omens need not be memorialized.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 3 Director Tang Ruowang told our section that eclipses, lunar and planetary encroachments, and omen readings need no longer be reported to court.

sentences.zh: 臣察湯若望推水星二八月皆伏不見，今於二月二十九日仍見東方，又八月二十四日夕見，皆關象佔，不敢不據推上聞。

translations.literal: Your servant observed that Tang Ruowang calculated Mercury invisible in both the second and eighth months, yet on the twenty-ninth of the second month it was still seen in the east, and on the evening of the twenty-fourth of the eighth month it was seen—these all concern omen interpretation; I dare not fail to report according to calculation.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Ruowang predicted Mercury hidden in both the second and eighth months—but on the twenty-ninth of the second it still appeared in the east, and on the evening of the twenty-fourth of the eighth as well; such signs bear on divination, and I must report what the math shows.

sentences.zh: 乞上復存臣科，庶絕學獲傳。」

translations.literal: I beg Your Majesty to restore our section, so that this dying learning may be transmitted.
translations.idiomatic: I beg Your Majesty to restore our section, so this nearly lost science may survive."

sentences.zh: 並上十四年回回術推算太陰五星陵犯書，日月交食、天象佔驗圖像。

translations.literal: He also submitted writings on lunar and five-planet encroachments calculated by Muslim methods for the fourteenth year, and charts of solar and lunar eclipses and celestial omen interpretation.
translations.idiomatic: He also submitted Muslim calculations of lunar and planetary encroachments for Shunzhi 14, plus eclipse and omen charts.

sentences.zh: 別疏又舉湯若望舛謬三事：一、遺漏紫炁，一、顛倒觜參，一、顛倒羅計。

translations.literal: In a separate memorial he also cited three errors of Tang Ruowang: one, omitting Purple Vapor; one, reversing Turtle Beak and Three Stars; one, reversing Rahu and Ketu.
translations.idiomatic: A separate memorial listed three Tang Ruowang errors: omitting Purple Qi, reversing Turtle Beak and Three Stars, and reversing Rahu and Ketu.

sentences.zh: 八月，上命內大臣愛星阿及各部院大臣登觀像台測驗水星不見，議明炫罪，坐奏事詐不以實，律絞，援赦得免。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the emperor ordered Inner Minister Esen and ministers of all boards and departments to ascend the observatory platform and test whether Mercury was invisible; Mingxuan's offense was deliberated; he was convicted of memorializing fraudulently and not truthfully, punishable by strangulation by law, but obtained exemption through amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the emperor sent Inner Minister Esen and ministers from every yamen to the observatory to test Mercury's visibility. Wu Mingxuan was judged guilty of false reporting—strangulation by statute—but escaped through amnesty.

sentences.zh: 康熙五年，新安衛官生楊光先叩閽進所著摘謬論、選擇議，斥湯若望新法十謬，並指選擇榮親王葬期誤用洪範五行，下議政王等會同確議。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Kangxi, Xin'an Guard licentiate Yang Guangxian knocked at the gate and presented his Refutation of Errors and Selection Discourse, denouncing ten errors in Tang Ruowang's new method, and also pointing out that in selecting the burial date for Prince Rong the Hongfan Five Phases were wrongly used; the matter was sent to the regent princes and others for joint definitive deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 5, Xin'an Guard licentiate Yang Guangxian came to the palace gates with his "Picking Out Errors" and "On Date Selection," denouncing ten flaws in Tang Ruowang's method and accusing him of misapplying Hongfan five-phase rules to Prince Rong's burial date. The regents were ordered to decide.

sentences.zh: 議政王等議：「歷代舊法，每日十二時，分一百刻，新法改九十六刻。

translations.literal: The regent princes deliberated: "The old methods of successive dynasties divided each day into twelve double-hours and one hundred quarter-hours; the new method changed this to ninety-six quarter-hours.
translations.idiomatic: The regents replied: "Tradition divided each day into twelve double-hours and one hundred quarter-hours; the new method uses ninety-six.

sentences.zh: 康熙三年立春候氣，先期起管，湯若望妄奏春氣已應參、觜二宿，改調次序，四餘刪去紫炁。

translations.literal: In the third year of Kangxi, at the Beginning of Spring qi observation, the tube sounded early; Tang Ruowang falsely memorialized that spring qi had already responded in the lodges Three Stars and Turtle Beak, altered the sequence, and in the four residuals deleted Purple Vapor.
translations.idiomatic: At Kangxi 3's Beginning of Spring qi test the pitch-pipe sounded early; Tang Ruowang falsely reported spring qi in Three Stars and Turtle Beak, rearranged the sequence, and dropped Purple Qi from the four residuals.

sentences.zh: 天祐皇上，歷祚無疆，湯若望祗進二百年曆。

translations.literal: Heaven blesses the emperor; the reign shall be boundless—yet Tang Ruowang presented only a two-hundred-year calendar.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven blesses the emperor with boundless reign—yet Tang Ruowang submitted a calendar of only two hundred years.

sentences.zh: 選榮親王葬期不用正五行，反用洪範五行，山嚮年月俱犯忌殺，事犯重大。

translations.literal: In selecting Prince Rong's burial date the orthodox Five Phases were not used; instead the Hongfan Five Phases were used—the mountain orientation and year and month all violated taboo killings; the matter was gravely serious.
translations.idiomatic: For Prince Rong's burial date he ignored orthodox Five Phases and used Hongfan Five Phases instead—the mountain orientation, year, and month all breached taboo killings; the offense was grave.

sentences.zh: 湯若望及刻漏科杜如預、五官挈壺正楊宏量、歷科李祖白、春官正宋可成、秋官正宋發、冬官正硃光顯、中官正劉有泰皆凌遲處死；

translations.literal: Tang Ruowang and Clepsydra Section Du Ruyu, Five Offices Water-clock Officer Yang Hongliang, Calendar Section Li Zubai, Spring Officer Song Kecheng, Autumn Officer Song Fa, Winter Officer Zhu Guangxian, and Central Officer Liu Youtai were all sentenced to death by slicing;
translations.idiomatic: Tang Ruowang, Clepsydra officer Du Ruyu, water-clock officer Yang Hongliang, calendar officer Li Zubai, Spring Officer Song Kecheng, Autumn Officer Song Fa, Winter Officer Zhu Guangxian, and Central Officer Liu Youtai were all sentenced to death by slicing;

sentences.zh: 故監官子劉必遠、賈文鬱、可成子哲、祖白子實、湯若望義子潘盡孝皆斬。」

translations.literal: Former Bureau official's son Liu Biyuan, Jia Wenyu, Kecheng's son Zhe, Zubai's son Shi, and Tang Ruowang's adopted son Pan Jinxiao were all sentenced to decapitation.
translations.idiomatic: Former Bureau official Liu Biyuan, Jia Wenyu, Song Kecheng's son Zhe, Li Zubai's son Shi, and Tang Ruowang's adopted son Pan Jinxiao were all sentenced to decapitation."

sentences.zh: 得旨，湯若望效力多年，又復衰老，杜如預、楊宏量勘定陵地有勞，皆免死，並令覆議。

translations.literal: Receiving the rescript, Tang Ruowang had served effectively for many years and was again aged; Du Ruyu and Yang Hongliang had labored in surveying the tomb site—all were spared death, and the matter was ordered reconsidered.
translations.idiomatic: The throne replied: Tang Ruowang had served many years and was now old; Du Ruyu and Yang Hongliang had toiled surveying the tomb site—all were spared death, and the case was sent back for review.

sentences.zh: 議政王等覆議，湯若望流徙，餘如前議。

translations.literal: The regent princes reconsidered: Tang Ruowang to exile; the rest as in the previous deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: On reconsideration the regents sentenced Tang Ruowang to exile; the rest as before.

sentences.zh: 得旨，湯若望等並免流徙，祖白、可成、發、光顯、有泰皆斬。

translations.literal: Receiving the rescript, Tang Ruowang and the others were all spared exile; Zubai, Kecheng, Fa, Guangxian, and Youtai were all decapitated.
translations.idiomatic: The throne spared Tang Ruowang and the others exile; Li Zubai, Song Kecheng, Song Fa, Zhu Guangxian, and Liu Youtai were executed.

sentences.zh: 自是廢新法不用。

translations.literal: From this the new method was abolished and not used.
translations.idiomatic: From then on the new method was abandoned.

sentences.zh: 聖祖既親政，以南懷仁治理曆法，光先坐譴黜，復用新法。

translations.literal: After the Sacred Ancestor personally took governance, Nan Huai Ren was put in charge of governing the calendar; Guangxian was punished and dismissed, and the new method was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Once Kangxi took personal rule, he put Nan Huai Ren in charge of the calendar, punished and dismissed Yang Guangxian, and restored the new method.

sentences.zh: 時湯若望已前卒，复通微教師封號，視原品賜卹，改「通玄」曰「通微」，避聖祖諱也。

translations.literal: By then Tang Ruowang had already died earlier; his title Master of Penetrating Subtlety was restored, condolence gifts were granted according to his original rank, and "Penetrating Mysteries" was changed to "Penetrating Subtlety" to avoid the Sacred Ancestor's taboo.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Ruowang had already died; his title Master of Penetrating Subtlety was restored, condolence honors were paid at his former rank, and "Penetrating Mysteries" became "Penetrating Subtlety" to avoid Kangxi's taboo name.

sentences.zh: 楊光先，字長公，江南歙縣人。

translations.literal: Yang Guangxian, style Changgong, was a native of She County in Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Guangxian, style Changgong, was from She County in Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 在明時為新安所千戶。

translations.literal: During Ming he was a battalion commander of Xin'an Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Ming he held the rank of battalion commander in Xin'an Guard.

sentences.zh: 崇禎十年，上疏劾大學士溫體仁、給事中陳啟新，舁棺自隨。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Chongzhen he memorialized impeaching Grand Secretary Wen Tiren and Censor Chen Qixin, carrying a coffin with him.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongzhen 10 he memorialized against Grand Secretary Wen Tiren and Censor Chen Qixin, bearing a coffin with him to show he was ready to die for the charge.

sentences.zh: 廷杖，戍遼西。

translations.literal: He was beaten at court and exiled to western Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: He was beaten at court and exiled to western Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 國初，命湯若望治歷用新法，頒時憲曆書，面題「依西洋新法」五字。

translations.literal: At the founding of the dynasty, Tang Ruowang was ordered to govern the calendar using the new method; the issued Shixian calendar books bore on their face the five characters "According to the Western Ocean New Method."
translations.idiomatic: Early in the dynasty Tang Ruowang was ordered to govern the calendar by the new method; the Shixian calendar books bore on their cover the five characters "According to the Western new method."

sentences.zh: 光先上書，謂非所宜用。

translations.literal: Guangxian memorialized, saying this was not what should be used.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Guangxian wrote that this should not be used.

sentences.zh: 既又論湯若望誤以順治十八年閏十月為閏七月，上所為摘謬、辟邪諸論，攻湯若望甚力，斥所奉天主教為妄言惑眾。

translations.literal: He then again argued that Tang Ruowang had mistakenly taken the intercalary tenth month of Shunzhi 18 as the intercalary seventh month; the emperor composed the Refutation of Errors and various treatises repelling heterodoxy, attacking Tang Ruowang with great force and denouncing the Catholicism he professed as wild talk deluding the masses.
translations.idiomatic: He then argued that Tang Ruowang had wrongly made Shunzhi 18's intercalary tenth month into an intercalary seventh; the emperor's "Picking Out Errors" and anti-heterodoxy essays attacked Tang Ruowang fiercely and denounced Catholicism as delusion misleading the people.

sentences.zh: 聖祖即位，四輔臣執政，頗右光先，下禮、吏二部會鞫。

translations.literal: When the Sacred Ancestor ascended the throne, the four assisting ministers held power and largely favored Guangxian; the case was sent to the Ministries of Rites and Personnel for joint interrogation.
translations.idiomatic: When Kangxi ascended the throne the four regent ministers favored Yang Guangxian and sent the case to the Ministries of Rites and Personnel for joint trial.

sentences.zh: 康熙四年，議政王等定讞，盡用光先說，譴湯若望，其屬官至坐死。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Kangxi the regent princes fixed the verdict, wholly adopting Guangxian's views, censuring Tang Ruowang, and his subordinate officials punished up to death.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 4 the regents fixed the verdict wholly on Yang Guangxian's side, censured Tang Ruowang, and punished his subordinates up to death.

sentences.zh: 遂罷新法，復用大統術。

translations.literal: The new method was then abolished and the Datong system restored.
translations.idiomatic: The new method was abandoned and the Datong system restored.

sentences.zh: 除光先右監副，疏辭，不許；

translations.literal: Guangxian was appointed Right Assistant Director; he memorialized to decline and was not permitted;
translations.idiomatic: Yang Guangxian was made Right Assistant Director; he asked to decline and was refused;

sentences.zh: 即授監正，疏辭，復不許。

translations.literal: He was immediately appointed Director; he memorialized to decline and again was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: He was then made Director; he declined again and was again refused.

sentences.zh: 光先編次其所為書，命曰不得已，持舊說繩湯若望。

translations.literal: Guangxian compiled his writings and named them Unavoidable, holding to old doctrines to bind Tang Ruowang.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Guangxian compiled his writings under the title Unavoidable, using old doctrine to hold Tang Ruowang to account.

sentences.zh: 顧學術自審不逮遠甚，既屢辭不獲，乃引吳明烜為監副。

translations.literal: Yet he himself judged his learning far inferior; having repeatedly declined without success, he brought in Wu Mingxuan as Assistant Director.
translations.idiomatic: Knowing his own learning fell far short, and having failed repeatedly to decline the post, he brought in Wu Mingxuan as Assistant Director.

sentences.zh: 明烜，明炫兄弟行，明炫議復回回科不得請，至是明烜副光先任推算。

translations.literal: Mingxuan was Mingxuan's younger brother; Mingxuan's petition to restore the Muslim section had not been granted—now Mingxuan assisted Guangxian in charge of calculations.
translations.idiomatic: Mingxuan was Wu Mingxuan's younger brother; Wu Mingxuan's petition to restore the Muslim section had failed—now Mingxuan served as Yang Guangxian's deputy for calculations.

sentences.zh: 五年春，光先疏言：「今候氣法久失傳，十二月中氣不應。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fifth year Guangxian memorialized: "The qi-observation method has long been lost; in the twelfth month the mid-qi did not respond.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Kangxi 5 Yang Guangxian wrote: "The qi-observation method has long been lost; in the twelfth month the mid-term did not respond.

sentences.zh: 乞許臣延訪博學有心計之人，與之制器測候，並飭禮部採宜陽金門山竹管、上黨羊頭山秬黍、河內葭莩備用。」

translations.literal: I beg permission to seek out learned men of purpose, make instruments with them for observation, and also order the Ministry of Rites to gather bamboo tubes from Jinmen Mountain in Yiyang, black millet from Yangtou Mountain in Shangdang, and reed membranes from Henei for use.
translations.idiomatic: I beg leave to seek learned and capable men, build instruments with them for observation, and have the Ministry of Rites gather bamboo tubes from Jinmen Mountain in Yiyang, black millet from Yangtou Mountain in Shangdang, and reed membranes from Henei for use."

sentences.zh: 七年，光先复疏言：「律管尺寸，載在史記，而用法失傳。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Guangxian again memorialized: "The dimensions of pitch pipes are recorded in the Records of the Grand Historian, but the method of use has been lost.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 7 Yang Guangxian wrote again: "Pitch-pipe dimensions are recorded in the Records of the Grand Historian, but the method of use has been lost.

sentences.zh: 今訪求能候氣者，尚未能致。

translations.literal: Now in seeking those who can observe qi, I have not yet been able to obtain any.
translations.idiomatic: I have sought those who can observe qi, but have not yet found any.

sentences.zh: 臣病風痺，未能董理。」

translations.literal: Your servant suffers from wind paralysis and cannot personally oversee the work.
translations.idiomatic: I suffer from rheumatism and cannot oversee the work myself."

sentences.zh: 下禮部，言光先職監正，不當自諉，仍令訪求能候氣者。

translations.literal: The matter was sent to the Ministry of Rites, which said that as Director Guangxian should not shirk responsibility, and he was still ordered to seek those who could observe qi.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites replied that as Director he should not shirk duty, and ordered him still to seek those who could observe qi.

sentences.zh: 是時朝廷知光先學術不勝任，復用西洋人南懷仁治理曆法。

translations.literal: At this time the court knew Guangxian's learning was not up to the task and again employed the Western Ocean man Nan Huai Ren to govern the calendar.
translations.idiomatic: By then the court knew Yang Guangxian's learning was inadequate and again put the Westerner Nan Huai Ren in charge of the calendar.

sentences.zh: 南懷仁疏劾明烜造康熙八年七政民歷於是年十二月置閏，應在康熙九年正月，又一歲兩春分、兩秋分，種種舛誤，下議政王等會議。

translations.literal: Nan Huai Ren memorialized impeaching Mingxuan for compiling the Kangxi 8 Seven Luminaries Popular Calendar with an intercalation placed in the twelfth month of that year when it should have been in the first month of Kangxi 9, and for one year having two Spring Equinoxes and two Autumn Equinoxes—every sort of error; the matter was sent to the regent princes for joint deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Nan Huai Ren impeached Mingxuan for the Kangxi 8 popular calendar: intercalation wrongly placed in the twelfth month instead of Kangxi 9's first, two spring equinoxes and two autumn equinoxes in one year—errors of every kind. The regents were ordered to decide.

sentences.zh: 議政王等議，曆法精微，難以遽定，請命大臣督同測驗。

translations.literal: The regent princes deliberated that calendrical methods are subtle and fine, difficult to decide hastily, and requested that ministers be ordered to supervise joint testing.
translations.idiomatic: The regents replied that calendar method is subtle and could not be settled hastily; they asked that ministers supervise joint testing.

sentences.zh: 八年，上遣大學士圖海等二十人會監正馬祜測驗立春、雨水兩節氣及太陰火、木二星躔度，南懷仁言悉應，明烜言悉不應。

translations.literal: In the eighth year the emperor dispatched Grand Secretary Tu Hai and twenty others together with Director Ma Hu to test the two solar terms Beginning of Spring and Rain Water and the positions of the moon and the fire and wood stars; Nan Huai Ren said all matched, Mingxuan said none matched.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 8 the emperor sent Grand Secretary Tu Hai and twenty others with Director Ma Hu to test Beginning of Spring, Rain Water, and the positions of the moon and the fire and wood stars—Nan Huai Ren said all matched; Mingxuan said none did.

sentences.zh: 議政王等疏請以康熙九年曆日交南懷仁推算，上問：「光先前劾湯若望，議政王大臣會議，以光先何者為是，湯若望何者為非，及新法當日議停，今日議复，其故安在？」

translations.literal: The regent princes memorialized requesting that the calendar days for Kangxi 9 be entrusted to Nan Huai Ren for calculation; the emperor asked: "When Guangxian formerly impeached Tang Ruowang, the regent princes and ministers jointly deliberated—what of Guangxian's was correct, what of Tang Ruowang's was wrong, and when the new method was then deliberated to be stopped, today it is deliberated to be restored—what is the reason?"
translations.idiomatic: The regents asked that Kangxi 9's calendar be entrusted to Nan Huai Ren. The emperor asked: "When Yang Guangxian impeached Tang Ruowang, the regents decided in Yang's favor—what was he right about, what was Tang wrong about? The new method was then stopped; today it is restored—why?"

sentences.zh: 議政王等疏言：「前命大學士圖海等二十人赴觀像台測驗，南懷仁所言悉應，吳明烜所言悉不應，問監正馬祜，監副宜塔喇、胡振鉞、李光顯，皆言南懷仁曆法上合天象。

translations.literal: The regent princes memorialized: "Previously Grand Secretary Tu Hai and twenty others were ordered to the observatory platform for testing; all Nan Huai Ren said matched, all Wu Mingxuan said did not match; questioning Director Ma Hu and Assistant Directors Yitara, Hu Zhenyue, and Li Guangxian—all said Nan Huai Ren's calendar method accorded with celestial phenomena above.
translations.idiomatic: The regents replied: "Grand Secretary Tu Hai and twenty others tested at the observatory—Nan Huai Ren matched throughout, Wu Mingxuan did not. Director Ma Hu and Assistant Directors Yitara, Hu Zhenyue, and Li Guangxian all said Nan Huai Ren's calendar accorded with heaven.

sentences.zh: 一日百刻，歷代成法，今南懷仁推算九十六刻，既合天象，自康熙九年始，應按九十六刻推行。

translations.literal: One hundred quarter-hours in a day is the established method of successive dynasties; now Nan Huai Ren calculates ninety-six quarter-hours, which already matches celestial phenomena; from Kangxi 9 onward, ninety-six quarter-hours should be adopted.
translations.idiomatic: One hundred quarter-hours per day is the tradition; Nan Huai Ren's ninety-six match heaven—from Kangxi 9 onward, ninety-six quarter-hours should be used.

sentences.zh: 南懷仁言羅睺、計都、月孛、推歷所用，故入歷；

translations.literal: Nan Huai Ren said Rahu, Ketu, and the lunar apogee node are used in calendar calculation and therefore enter the calendar;
translations.idiomatic: Nan Huai Ren said Rahu, Ketu, and the lunar apogee node are used in calendar calculation and belong in the calendar;

sentences.zh: 紫炁無象，推歷所不用，故不入歷。

translations.literal: Purple Vapor has no visible form and is not used in calendar calculation, therefore it does not enter the calendar.
translations.idiomatic: Purple Qi has no visible form and is not used in calendar calculation, so it does not belong in the calendar.

sentences.zh: 自康熙九年始，紫炁不必造入七政歷。」

translations.literal: From Kangxi 9 onward, Purple Vapor need not be included in the Seven Luminaries Calendar.
translations.idiomatic: From Kangxi 9 onward, Purple Qi need not be included in the Seven Luminaries calendar."

sentences.zh: 又言：「候氣為古法，推歷亦無所用，嗣後並應停止。

translations.literal: They also said: "Qi observation is an ancient method, also useless for calendar calculation; hereafter it should altogether be stopped.
translations.idiomatic: They also said: "Qi observation is an ancient method, useless for calendar calculation; hereafter it should be discontinued altogether.

sentences.zh: 請將光先奪官，交刑部議罪。」

translations.literal: It is requested that Guangxian be stripped of office and sent to the Ministry of Punishments for deliberation of punishment.
translations.idiomatic: They asked that Yang Guangxian be stripped of office and sent to the Ministry of Punishments for sentencing."

sentences.zh: 上命光先但奪官，免其罪。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered that Guangxian only be stripped of office and his punishment waived.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Yang Guangxian stripped of office but spared punishment.

sentences.zh: 南懷仁等復呈告光先依附鼇拜，將歷代所用洪範五行稱為滅蠻經，致李祖白等無辜被戮，援引吳明烜誣告湯若望謀叛。

translations.literal: Nan Huai Ren and others again memorialized accusing Guangxian of attaching himself to Oboi, calling the Hongfan Five Phases used by successive dynasties the Scripture for Destroying Barbarians, causing Li Zubai and others to be executed innocently, and citing Wu Mingxuan's false accusation that Tang Ruowang plotted rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Nan Huai Ren and others further accused Yang Guangxian of siding with Oboi, calling the Hongfan Five Phases used through the ages the "Scripture for Destroying Barbarians," causing the innocent execution of Li Zubai and others, and citing Wu Mingxuan's false charge that Tang Ruowang plotted rebellion.

sentences.zh: 下議政王等議，坐光先斬，上以光先老，貸其死，遣回籍，道卒。

translations.literal: The matter was sent to the regent princes for deliberation; Guangxian was convicted to decapitation; the emperor, because Guangxian was old, commuted his death, sent him back to his native place, and he died on the road.
translations.idiomatic: The regents sentenced Yang Guangxian to decapitation; the emperor, citing his age, spared his life and sent him home—he died on the way.

sentences.zh: 刑部議明烜坐奏事不實，當杖流，上命笞四十釋之。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Punishments deliberated that Mingxuan was guilty of memorializing untruthfully, punishable by beating and exile; the emperor ordered forty blows with the cane and release.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Punishments found Mingxuan guilty of false reporting—beatings and exile by statute; the emperor ordered forty blows with the cane and release.

sentences.zh: 南懷仁，初名佛迪南特斯，姓阜泌斯脫氏，比利時國人。

translations.literal: Nan Huai Ren, whose original name was Ferdinand, surname Verbist, was a native of Belgium.
translations.idiomatic: Nan Huai Ren—born Ferdinand Verbist—was a Belgian.

sentences.zh: 康熙初，入中國。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Kangxi he entered China.
translations.idiomatic: He came to China early in the Kangxi reign.

sentences.zh: 時湯若望方黜，楊光先為監正，吳明烜為監副，以大統術治歷，節氣不應，金、水二星躔度舛錯。

translations.literal: At that time Tang Ruowang had just been dismissed, Yang Guangxian was Director, Wu Mingxuan was Assistant Director; they governed the calendar by the Datong system—the solar terms did not match, and the positions of the metal and water stars were wrong.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Ruowang had just been dismissed; Yang Guangxian was Director and Wu Mingxuan Assistant Director. They governed the calendar by the Datong system—seasonal terms failed to match, and the positions of Venus and Mercury were wrong.

sentences.zh: 明烜奏水星當見，其言復不售。

translations.literal: Mingxuan memorialized that Mercury should be visible, but his words again did not prevail.
translations.idiomatic: Mingxuan reported that Mercury should be visible—but once again his prediction failed.

sentences.zh: 乃召南懷仁，命治理曆法。

translations.literal: Nan Huai Ren was then summoned and ordered to govern the calendar.
translations.idiomatic: Nan Huai Ren was summoned and put in charge of the calendar.

sentences.zh: 南懷仁劾光先、明烜而去之，遂授南懷仁監副。

translations.literal: Nan Huai Ren impeached Guangxian and Mingxuan and had them removed; Nan Huai Ren was then appointed Assistant Director.
translations.idiomatic: Nan Huai Ren impeached Yang Guangxian and Mingxuan and had them removed, then was made Assistant Director.

sentences.zh: 時三月，南懷仁言是歲按舊法以十一月置閏，以新法測驗，閏當在九年正月。

translations.literal: At that time, in the third month, Nan Huai Ren said that by the old method that year an intercalation was placed in the eleventh month, but by the new method tested, the intercalation should be in the first month of the ninth year.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Nan Huai Ren said that by the old method the year had an intercalary eleventh month, but testing by the new method showed the intercalation belonged in Kangxi 9's first month.

sentences.zh: 既又言是月二十九日雨水，乃正月中氣，即為康熙九年之正月，閏當在是年二月。

translations.literal: He further said that Rain Water on the twenty-ninth of that month was the mid-qi of the first month—that is, the first month of Kangxi 9—and the intercalation should be in the second month of that year.
translations.idiomatic: He added that Rain Water on the twenty-ninth of that month was the mid-term of the first month—making it Kangxi 9's first month, with intercalation in the second month of that year.

sentences.zh: 上命禮部詢欽天監官，多從南懷仁，乃罷八年十二月閏，移置九年二月；

translations.literal: The emperor ordered the Ministry of Rites to consult Astronomical Bureau officials; most followed Nan Huai Ren, and the intercalation of the twelfth month of the eighth year was abolished and moved to the second month of the ninth year;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had the Ministry of Rites consult Bureau officials; most sided with Nan Huai Ren, so Kangxi 8's intercalary twelfth month was cancelled and moved to Kangxi 9's second month;

sentences.zh: 節氣佔候，悉用南懷仁說。

translations.literal: Solar term observation and divination all followed Nan Huai Ren's views.
translations.idiomatic: Seasonal-term observation and divination all followed Nan Huai Ren's method.

sentences.zh: 六月，南懷仁請改造觀像台儀器，從之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Nan Huai Ren requested to rebuild the observatory platform instruments; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Nan Huai Ren asked to rebuild the observatory instruments; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 十二月，儀器成，擢南懷仁監正。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the instruments were completed, and Nan Huai Ren was promoted to Director.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the instruments were finished, and Nan Huai Ren was promoted to Director.

sentences.zh: 儀凡六：曰黃道經緯儀，曰赤道經緯儀，曰地平經儀，曰地平緯儀，曰紀限儀，曰天體儀；

translations.literal: The instruments numbered six in all: called the ecliptic armillary sphere, the equatorial armillary sphere, the azimuth instrument, the altitude instrument, the quadrant instrument, and the celestial globe;
translations.idiomatic: There were six instruments in all: an ecliptic armillary sphere, an equatorial armillary sphere, an azimuth instrument, an altitude instrument, a quadrant, and a celestial globe;

sentences.zh: 並繪圖立說，次為靈臺儀象志。

translations.literal: Illustrations and explanations were also drawn up, compiled afterward as the Treatise on Observatory Instruments and Phenomena.
translations.idiomatic: He also drew illustrations and wrote explanations, compiled as the Treatise on Observatory Instruments and Phenomena.

sentences.zh: 十七年，進康熙永年表，表推七政交食，為湯若望未竟之書，南懷仁續成之。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he presented the Kangxi Perpetual Tables, which calculated seven-luminaries eclipses—a book Tang Ruowang had left unfinished, which Nan Huai Ren completed.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 17 he presented the Kangxi Perpetual Tables for seven-luminaries eclipses—Tang Ruowang's unfinished work, which Nan Huai Ren completed.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，命南懷仁至盛京測北極高度，較京師高二度，別為推算日月交食表上之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year Nan Huai Ren was ordered to go to Shengjing to measure the altitude of the north pole, which was two degrees higher than at the capital; separate solar and lunar eclipse tables were calculated and submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 21 Nan Huai Ren was sent to Shengjing to measure polar altitude—two degrees higher than Beijing—and submitted separately computed eclipse tables.

sentences.zh: 南懷仁官監正久，累加至工部侍郎。

translations.literal: Nan Huai Ren served long as Director and was cumulatively promoted to Vice Minister of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Nan Huai Ren served long as Director and was eventually promoted to Vice Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，卒，諡勤敏。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year he died; posthumous title Qinmin.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 27 he died; his posthumous title was Qinmin, "Diligent and Keen."

sentences.zh: 自是欽天監用西洋人，累進為監正、監副，相繼不絕。

translations.literal: From this the Astronomical Bureau employed Westerners, who were cumulatively promoted to Director and Assistant Director in unbroken succession.
translations.idiomatic: From then on the Astronomical Bureau employed Westerners, who rose in unbroken succession to Director and Assistant Director.

sentences.zh: 五十四年，命紀理安制地平經緯儀，合地平、​​象限二儀為一。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fourth year Ignatius Kögler was ordered to make an azimuth-altitude instrument, combining the azimuth and quadrant instruments into one.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 54 Ignatius Kögler was ordered to build an azimuth-altitude instrument, combining azimuth and quadrant into one.

sentences.zh: 乾隆中，戴進賢、徐懋德、劉松齡、傅作霖皆賜進士。

translations.literal: During Qianlong, Ignatius Sichelbarth, Franz Xaver von Hallerstein, Augustin von Hallerstein, and Felix da Rocha were all granted jinshi degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Under Qianlong, Ignatius Sichelbarth, Franz Xaver von Hallerstein, Augustin von Hallerstein, and Felix da Rocha were all granted jinshi degrees.

sentences.zh: 道光間，高拱宸等或歸國，或病卒。

translations.literal: During Daoguang, Gao Gongchen and others either returned to their countries or died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the Daoguang era, Gao Gongchen and others either returned home or died of illness.

sentences.zh: 時監官已深習西法，不必復用西洋人，奏奉宣宗諭，停西洋人入監。

translations.literal: By then Bureau officials had deeply mastered Western methods and Westerners need not be employed again; a memorial received the Xuanzong Emperor's instruction to stop Westerners from entering the Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: By then Bureau officials had mastered Western methods and Westerners were no longer needed; on memorial the Daoguang Emperor ordered that Westerners cease entering the Bureau.

sentences.zh: 方聖祖用南懷仁，許奉天主教，仍其國俗，而禁各省立堂入教。

translations.literal: When the Sacred Ancestor employed Nan Huai Ren, Catholic worship was permitted, their national customs retained, but provinces were forbidden to establish churches and receive converts.
translations.idiomatic: When Kangxi employed Nan Huai Ren, Catholics were allowed to practice their faith and keep their customs, but provinces were forbidden to build churches or receive converts.

sentences.zh: 是時各省天主堂已三十餘所。

translations.literal: At that time Catholic churches in the provinces already numbered more than thirty.
translations.idiomatic: By then there were already more than thirty Catholic churches in the provinces.

sentences.zh: 雍正間，禁令嚴，盡毀去，但留京師一所，俾西洋人入監者居之。

translations.literal: During Yongzheng the prohibition was strict; all were destroyed, leaving only one in the capital for Westerners entering the Bureau to reside in.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yongzheng the ban was strict; churches were destroyed throughout the empire, save one in the capital for Westerners serving in the Bureau.

sentences.zh: 入內地傳教，輒繩以法。

translations.literal: Entering the interior to preach was always punished by law.
translations.idiomatic: Missionary work in the interior was always punished by law.

sentences.zh: 迨停西洋人入監，未幾海禁弛，傳教入條約，新舊教堂遍內地矣。

translations.literal: When Westerners ceased entering the Bureau, before long the maritime prohibition was relaxed, missionary activity entered treaties, and old and new churches spread throughout the interior.
translations.idiomatic: After Westerners ceased entering the Bureau, the maritime ban soon eased, missionary rights entered treaties, and old and new churches spread across the interior.

sentences.zh: 論曰：曆算之術，愈入則愈深，愈進則愈密。

translations.literal: The commentators say: In calendrical and computational arts, the deeper one enters the deeper they become, the further one advances the finer they grow.
translations.idiomatic: The commentators observe: calendar and computation grow deeper with every advance and finer with every step forward.

sentences.zh: 湯若望、南懷仁所述作，與楊光先所攻訐，淺深疏密，今人人能言之。

translations.literal: The writings of Tang Ruowang and Nan Huai Ren, and the attacks of Yang Guangxian—their shallowness and depth, looseness and fineness—today everyone can speak of.
translations.idiomatic: The writings of Tang Ruowang and Nan Huai Ren and the attacks of Yang Guangxian—who was shallow and who deep, loose and who precise—today anyone can judge.

sentences.zh: 其在當日，嫉忌遠人，牽涉宗教，引繩批根，互為起僕，誠一時得失之林也。

translations.literal: At the time, envy of foreigners, entanglement with religion, pulling ropes to strike at roots, rising and falling in turn against one another—truly a thicket of momentary gains and losses.
translations.idiomatic: At the time, envy of foreigners, religious entanglement, and mutual factional strikes made a thicket of passing gains and losses.

sentences.zh: 聖祖嘗言當曆法爭議未已，己所未學，不能定是非，乃發憤揅討，卒能深造密微，窮極其閫奧。

translations.literal: The Sacred Ancestor once said that when calendar disputes had not yet ceased, what he himself had not studied he could not judge right from wrong; he then applied himself in indignation to research, and in the end attained profound subtlety, exhausting the innermost mysteries.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi once said that while calendar disputes raged he could not judge what he had not studied; he then threw himself into the subject in earnest and mastered its subtlest depths.

sentences.zh: 為天下主，虛己勵學如是。

translations.literal: As ruler of all under Heaven, to empty oneself and encourage learning thus.
translations.idiomatic: As ruler of the realm, to humble oneself and pursue learning so—

sentences.zh: 嗚呼，聖矣！

translations.literal: Alas, how sagely!
translations.idiomatic: —how sagely indeed!
